name: CoA Custom races: female characters of the male-only races are refused at creation
contract: The CoA Custom races package has no female model for Tuskarr (15), Taunka (17), Vrykul (18), Fel Orc (23), Forest Troll (24), Ice Troll (25) and Skeleton (26); the client crashes on it. Thin Human (32) and Furbolg (50) have a single model for both sexes on which female gear stretches across the screen (CoA Custom 1.4), and Gnoll (83) and Saberon (97) have a male model only.

Broken (22) is Eunoia's Broken with its own female model (CreatureDisplayInfo 977440, Character/Broken/Female/BrokenFemale) and 560 female CharSections rows, so its female is created (CoA Custom 1.3 dropped it from the list).
CMSG_CHAR_CREATE with gender 1 for a male-only race is answered with CHAR_CREATE_DISABLED; the male character of the same race and a female character of a race with a female model are created.
Skeleton is Horde (ChrRaces team 1), so the Orc actor's account may hold it; Broken and Furbolg are Alliance (team 7) and go to the Human actor's account on a PvP realm.
Native SMSG_CHAR_CREATE answers are observed; the client's character screen is not rendered.
